parsed.summary: The PR adds a new attribute `refit_time_` to measure the time taken to refit the best model. The change is minimal and well-contained.

issues.description: The import statement for `time` is added at the top of the file, which is a minor stylistic change.
The documentation for `refit_time_` is added in the class docstrings, but it could be more detailed to explain how this attribute is calculated and when it is available.
